scope: Independent read-only CPU audit of the2W Source16 proposal and evolving runtime; no optical/GPU approval. Root owns subsequent corrections.

proxyMaterials.name: Visitor transport nonemissive photographic red gauze

findings.evidence: Actual light normalize=true, energy=2W, exposure=0, temperature=false, unitScale=1. Blender official candle reference0.05W visible radiant flux;2W is40times that power.
findings.suggestion: Preview0.05W shared source/runtime, then settle global camera exposure; no independent cloth gain and no unilateral683factor.

findings.issue: Physical cloth keeps28percent direct light in full opaque shadow
findings.evidence: Runtime physical radiance multiplied by mix(.28,1,shadowVisibility). Cycles opaque caps/ribs/cup block direct light, with indirect computed separately.
findings.suggestion: Use actual visibility in physical branch; actual hall environment supplies indirect. Keep artistic floor only in nonphysical fallback if needed.

findings.issue: Selected cloth colour/geometry differs from immutable far bake
findings.evidence: Far lamp map is source default30/red#a82a1c, scaled only by scalar power. Actual cream throughput over source red=[1,14.77695,20.96373]; brown=[1,6.01599,6.91519]. Runtime direct uses selected mask/colour.
findings.suggestion: Separate lamp indirect from live direct; bake lamp INDIRECT only, remove spatial handoff, bound recolouring approximation for indirect. Live direct requires static visibility first.

findings.issue: All-range direct currently lacks architectural visibility
findings.evidence: loadPlace disables castShadow on every static object. Live shadow camera far is6m.
findings.suggestion: Capture actual static radial depth at source basis once and combine with moving fixture visibility before enabling all-range direct; select far range covering all receiver geometry or document bounds.

findings.issue: Source and runtime cloth closures differ
findings.evidence: Source is.35 Diffuse+.65 Translucent with no sheen/GGX. Runtime is full MeshPhysical diffuse/specular plus.45sheen and an added.65 diffuse-transmission radiance on both sides. All6 actual fixture geometry vertices have negative normalDotIncoming, so current outside shell is back-lit and leading first-order transmission agrees; visible interior/front-lit faces may add extra energy. Sheen compensation alone multiplies injected radiance by.9723red/.9373cream/.9898brown.
findings.suggestion: Keep transmission only on opposite incident/outgoing hemisphere, scale same-side reflection to.35, and match source/runtime sheen/specular closures if exact material equivalence is required; otherwise document as approximate PBR representation.

findings.issue: Thumbnail source fallback used different colour
findings.evidence: OldnewColor0xffbd78 yielded[1,.50888,.18782], source is explicit scene-linear[1,.741176,.470588].
findings.suggestion: Use one immutable source-linear reference for thumbnails and main runtime; bind future source-power/reference revisions to cache key.

correctRelationships: Main runtime light RGB is fromArray(manifest.lampBasis.linearColor), preserving explicit scene-linear source.
W/(4pi) provides matching numeric radiometric intensity in inverse-square and BRDF/pi equations, despite lampCandela naming; adding photometric efficacy only on runtime would break matching.
uLampPower and physical cloth intensity share power*keep without temporal point-power noise for baked lighting.
Actual photographed weave repeat1.28/.96, luminance mean/clamp.66..1.24 and normal strength.38 agree at authoring level.
Runtime point and cloth emitter positions use the same actual source basis, including rigid local-to-world transforms.
